# Logging client provenance

`ps5log.h` is the unmodified logging client from mpereiraesaa/ps5-agc-gears, commit `1ae1f9182abd2770c131b97419034fb85173c2dc`. Its upstream project license (GPL version 3) is preserved in LICENSE. SHA-256 of the header: `394af67d0f8b60b3335deb53396e52855ea2daa50ca914a456ea7663f48900c6`. Lapy's own code remains MIT-licensed; do not describe the entire linked helper as MIT-only.
